newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks down in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks down in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks, including blue chips, closed the week down on Friday in lacklustre trade.
* Only two of 10 active issues rose, six fell and two were unchanged.
* Top gainer was hotelier Laguna, adding 50 kuna to close at 1,250 on volume of 147 shares.
* Drugs firm Pliva was the biggest loser, down 200 kuna to 13,500, with 43 units sold.
* Most actively traded food processor Podravka edged down nine kuna to 226, selling 1,939 shares.
